source: DOSBox Staging window, grabbed from Xvfb with ImageMagick import

source: DOSBox Staging window, grabbed from Xvfb with ImageMagick import
shows: FIZZ2.EXE /REPLAY in DOSBox, with the key carried (the chip in the HUD pill is filled) and Fizz 2: the chicken, stunned by Ben's shot, has two yellow and white stars above its head, and the caption red gumdrop floats where Ben took the key.

source: DOSBox Staging window, grabbed from Xvfb with ImageMagick import
shows: FIZZ2.EXE /REPLAY in DOSBox in the snack nook, about two thirds of the way through the script: Ben, with Fizz 0 and Deaths 1 in the HUD pill, has just taken a cheezie below the shelf, and the captions crunch (yellow) and click - no fizz (grey, from the empty blaster) float where they happened.

source: DOSBox Staging window, grabbed from Xvfb with ImageMagick import
shows: FIZZ2.EXE /REPLAY in DOSBox in the snack nook: Ben bounces on the pogo stick beside the right-hand wall of the gallery and the caption boing (yellow) floats at the spot of the bounce, with Fizz 0 and Deaths 1 in the HUD pill.

source: DOSBox Staging window, grabbed from Xvfb with ImageMagick import
shows: FIZZ2.EXE /REPLAY in DOSBox at the end of the script: Ben stands on the pogo stick at the open blue door in front of the exit with the caption ta-da! (light green) above him, Fizz 0 and Deaths 1 in the HUD pill and LEVEL CLEAR below.

source: DOSBox Staging window, grabbed from Xvfb with ImageMagick import
shows: FIZZ2.EXE /LIVE in DOSBox, keys typed through the X server: after a jump onto the first ledge Ben holds Up alone for 1.8 seconds, so he looks up and the view has risen to show the chicken, which has just clucked bwuk, bwuk.

source: DOSBox Staging window, grabbed from Xvfb with ImageMagick import
shows: FIZZ2.EXE /LIVE in DOSBox: Up and Space pressed together, so Ben raises the blaster and a shot rises above him, with the caption fzzt (Fizz 4 in the HUD pill).

source: DOSBox Staging window, grabbed from Xvfb with ImageMagick import
shows: FIZZ2.EXE /LIVE in DOSBox: Down and Space pressed while Ben is in the air after a jump, so he holds the blaster down, a shot falls below him and the caption fzzt floats by his head.

source: DOSBox Staging window, grabbed from Xvfb with ImageMagick import
shows: FIZZ2.EXE /LIVE in DOSBox after Esc, typed through the X server: the frozen picture dimmed behind the heading Paused with a light magenta rule, the rows Resume (chosen, on a light magenta plate with the soda can), Options and Quit to DOS, and the grey footer.

source: DOSBox Staging window, grabbed from Xvfb with ImageMagick import
shows: FIZZ2.EXE /LIVE in DOSBox after Esc, Down, Enter and Down: the Options screen over the dimmed picture with Music, Effects (chosen), Sound placement, Frame rate, Motion, Captions, Keys and Back, the values on the right in the Fizz colour, and the footer. A genuine DOSBox grab of the game, not the host drawing of the same screen.

source: FIZZ2.EXE /CHECKCELLS in DOSBox through tools/dosrun.sh, drawn by tools/render-cells.py
shows: The check screen of FIZZ2.EXE in DOSBox's default machine (VGA, a mouse, no joystick, no AdLib and no Sound Blaster, a 486 with an x87 and 14 MB free), drawn from the 80 by 25 text cells that FIZZ2.EXE /CHECKCELLS printed, by tools/render-cells.py with the machine's VGA console font: the PC speaker row is lit as the sound the game would use.

source: standard output of FIZZ2.EXE /REPLAY in DOSBox, through tools/dosrun.sh
shows: The transcript FIZZ2.EXE printed during the grabbed replay run.

source: standard output of FIZZ2.EXE /? in DOSBox, through tools/dosrun.sh
shows: The text of FIZZ2.EXE /? in DOSBox: the modes, the keys, the captions and the sound switches on one screen of 22 lines.

source: standard output of FIZZ2.EXE /PROBE in DOSBox, through tools/dosrun.sh
shows: The output of FIZZ2.EXE /PROBE in DOSBox's default machine: the PROBE lines for video, mouse, joystick, FM chip, Sound Blaster, BLASTER, x87, processor and free memory, then the CELLS hash, the SOUND line and the usual platform lines.
